gloss: ladies and gentlemen; everyone; you all

definitions.gloss: ladies and gentlemen; everyone; you all
definitions.explanation: A formal term of address used to speak to a group of people, especially in speeches, addresses, or written appeals. Has a somewhat old-fashioned or authoritative tone.

examples.japanese: {諸君|しょくん}、⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧{諸君|しょくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前途|ぜんと}→前途：09609_zento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: I congratulate the graduates on their future prospects.

examples.japanese: {諸君|しょくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健闘|けんとう}→健闘：15326_kentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{校長先生|こうちょうせんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: "I wish you all the best of luck," said the principal.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various, many) + ⟦{君|くん}→〜君：01998_kun⟧ (you). Used as a formal, somewhat old-fashioned form of address for a group. Often heard in graduation speeches, military addresses, and formal announcements. Can sound authoritative or paternal.

REGISTER:
Formal and somewhat stiff. More commonly used by older speakers or in ceremonial contexts. In casual speech, ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧ or ⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧ is preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧: everyone — the standard polite way to address a group
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧: everyone — casual form
